subject: general
question: An object is placed at a distance of 30 cm in front of a convex mirror of focal length 10 cm, on its principal axis. Its image is formed at:

options.text: a point between 20 cm and infinity (∞)
a point between 10 cm and 20 cm
a point between 0 cm and 10 cm

solution:
The correct answer is __**a point between 0 cm and 10 cm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To solve this, we can use the mirror formula for convex mirrors:** 1/f = 1/v+1/u**.

 
 
• **f** is the focal length of the mirror (for convex mirrors, it is positive)
 
• **v** is the image distance (which we need to find)
 
• **u** is the object distance (which is negative as per the sign convention)
